trust_decision.summary: Request parameters date_from/date_to are trusted as validated dates on the room-type (product) page: ProductController::init only checks them with strtotime-based HotelHelper::validateDateRangeForHotel, then assigns the raw strings to Smarty, and booking-form.tpl echoes them into hidden input value attributes without |escape (the 'Book Now' form). Unconfirmed as the published site because the fix diff is empty.

landing_point.why: The 'Book Now' button (booking-form.tpl:182) belongs to this form, and date_from/date_to are the only search parameters in the theme printed with no |escape modifier.

fix_sites.entry_point: unknown (fix.diff contains only a merge header, fix.diff:1-2, and no hunks)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown. No O2 site was found. The one plausible argument is that date_from/date_to are 'already validated' by validateDateRangeForHotel (strtotime) in ProductController::init, so the template output looks safe.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The same date_from/date_to values must still prefill the booking form and the JS date range picker, which arrive via addJsDef booking_date_from/booking_date_to. Rejecting or stripping real dates (e.g. 'Y-m-d H:i:s' produced by displayAjaxRefreshBookingForm) would break date prefill and availability refresh.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The search-panel check_in_time/check_out_time hidden inputs print search_data.date_from/date_to, which WkRoomSearchHelper takes raw from the request (modules/wkroomsearchblock/classes/WkRoomSearchHelper.php:173-175). They are escaped today; an unescaped copy is a realistic sibling in another module.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is the same raw parameter in a separate module and template. A maintainer adding a field to the search panel could copy the unescaped booking-form.tpl idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The filter block reads raw date_from/date_to/occupancy and feeds them into htlfilterblock.tpl (addJsDef, modules/wkhotelfilterblock/views/templates/hook/htlfilterblock.tpl:77-78) and a category URL. Printing them in HTML would be a distant sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This code sits in another package, receives the same 'Book Now' search parameters, and has no date validation of its own.

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 7.x/8.x with Smarty templates (PrestaShop 1.6-derived), web server
O10_build.project_tests: None for this area: tests/ contains only tests/bootstrap.php and tests/index.php.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add |escape:'html':'UTF-8' to booking-form.tpl:54-55, or normalise date_from/date_to with date('Y-m-d', strtotime()) in ProductController::initContent.

out_of_scope_notes: Admin calendar helper prints {$date_from}/{$date_to} unescaped (admin-dev/themes/default/template/helpers/calendar/calendar.tpl:65-67): different surface (back office), not pursued.
dashproducts prints {$date_from} {$date_to} unescaped (modules/dashproducts/views/templates/hook/dashboard_zone_two.tpl:80): admin dashboard, not pursued.
